integrity: Complete self-contained proof and standard-library integer verification program; no claim of independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Limited to exact two-element independent-set supports of simple cycles, not other cardinalities or cycle powers. Nonzero spectral magnitude multiplicities are not classified; unindexed prior signed-weight results remain a priority risk. Exact code checks finite lengths only, with all-length correctness supplied by proof.
title: A mod-eight Fourier rank law for nonadjacent pairs of a cycle
